title: GPT-4 contextualized programming exercise bank
summary: The authors generated 500 short Python exercises with contextual narratives, problem statements, and code solutions across programming concepts and 25 contexts. A rubric checks completeness, sensibility, correctness, and code quality before the exercises can be used with introductory students.
